column3: Execute a sequence of desktop actions in ONE tool call. Each individual tool call requires a model→API round trip (seconds); batching a predictable sequence eliminates all but one. Use this whenever you can predict the outcome of several actions ahead — e.g. click a field, type into it, press Return. Actions execute sequentially and stop on the first error. While "Require app grants" is on, the frontmost application must be granted, and the check runs before EACH action inside the batch — if an action brings an ungranted app forward, the next action's gate fires and the batch stops there. Screenshot and zoom actions are allowed and their images are returned with the per-action outputs. Coordinates you write in THIS batch — clicks AND zoom regions — always refer to the screenshot taken BEFORE this call, never to a zoom and never to a mid-batch screenshot. After the batch returns, the most recent full screenshot it produced becomes the new coordinate reference for your next call. There are no individual interaction tools (left_click, type, key, scroll, drag, …) — this is the only way to click, type, or otherwise interact with the computer. A single action is just a one-item batch.
